title: Campus tour of the University of Leeds
description:
Explore our vibrant campus at the University of Leeds. Our students will show you around our beautiful red brick single site campus. See our study areas, accommodation, green spaces where you can relax and the best places to get a coffee and meet up with your friends. Find out more about our 300 clubs, societies and sports facilities – there really is something for everyone. See the best locations on campus and discover the ways we support you when you are here. 

Discover why Leeds is a great place to live and learn. Think beyond. Experience it for yourself.  

Join our friendly campus community with students from 130 countries all over the world.  

Find out more: https://www.leeds.ac.uk/around-campus  

Discover more of our beautiful campus on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/universityofleeds

title: Waite Campus Tour
description:
Explore Adelaide University's Waite Campus, a leading centre for agriculture, food and wine education, research and innovation. Located just minutes from Adelaide's city centre, Waite brings together industry-standard facilities, hands-on learning and cutting-edge research in one specialist precinct. 

In this tour, discover the vineyards, teaching winery, food innovation laboratories and advanced plant research facilities where students learn alongside researchers and industry partners. From food production and wine science to sustainable agriculture and climate resilience, Waite is helping shape the future of food, agriculture and wine. 

Learn more about studying at Adelaide University. https://adelaide.edu.au/study/#undergraduate
